'''PC Errata''' are game-text corrections issued by the Players Committee. They are separate from Decipher's printed text and from Decipher's own errata in the Glossary Supplement.

PC errata cards are titled '''Title (PC Errata)'''. Decipher-era errata are titled '''Title (Errata)''' (example: [[Projective Telepathy (Errata)]]). Dated rules changes are listed on [[Players Committee rule changes]].

== Decipher and PC errata ==
These cards carry both Decipher errata and a PC rewrite. Both are listed on [[Errata#Decipher_and_PC_Errata|Errata — Decipher and PC Errata]].
* [[Attack Run (PC Errata 2)]] ([[Attack Run|original]]; earlier PC image: [[Attack Run (PC Errata)]])
* [[Blast The Door, Kid! (PC Errata)]]: PC wording first found in the PC ''Decipher Errata'' sheet of 2017 (official text as of 1 March 2017). Decipher errata (Glossary 2.0, November 1998): [[Blast The Door, Kid! (Errata)]]. Printed: [[Blast The Door, Kid!]].
* [[Evader (PC Errata 2)]] ([[Evader|original]]; earlier PC image: [[Evader (PC Errata)]])
* [[I've Got A Problem Here (PC Errata)]]: PC and Appendix A text: “with maneuver”. Decipher's [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]] (Updated 29 January 2002) supersedes [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] for the Decipher text. [[I've Got A Problem Here]] follows the PC text.

== PC errata ==
Each card's PC text is its Holotable card face and its entry in Appendix A of the 2023 Advanced Rulebook. The printed text is on the card's original page. These cards are also listed on [[Errata#PC_Errata|Errata — PC Errata]].
